content: <thought>We have five candidate templates from the catalog search. To identify the correct one, we will test each template’s applicability to the target molecule (CC(C)(C)OC(=O)Nc1ccccc1NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=CC(=O)O)cc2) using check_smiles_reaction_template_matching. The template that returns True is the one that reproduces the Doebner modification. Once found, we will return its mapped_rxn and the integer template_id (the “reaction_id” field, which serves as the template identifier in the required format).
